description: First live floor scenario: one legible secrets-in-logs seed (a bearer token logged in plaintext on login) plus one plausible-but-clean control locus (a non-secret session id logged on logout). 1 seed => INSTANCE-LEVEL: a class-level PASS/FAIL is not claimable; the honest verdict is UNKNOWN (machinery ran end-to-end, underpowered). Rebuild the repo with fixtures/build_floor_secrets_001.sh; the base/head SHAs below come from that builder.

seeded_defects.description: login() logs the bearer token in plaintext: logger.info(... token=%s ..., api_token)

control_loci.description: logout() logs a session id alongside the user id. Security-adjacent and easy to over-flag, but the session id is a non-secret rotating identifier — a flag here is a false positive.
